author: arusinoff
body:
I would say if you are T4, upgrading all gear to lvl 4 should be enough :) On T5 -> to lvl 5 and so on.

But it's worth it to upgrade only legendary or ornate gear. Don't waste mats on lower quality gear in general :)

For higher tier gear most likely you will need higher tier mats, and not the ones you could buy in the market :) Lower tier mats will be required in huge quantities for ascensions and recycling in Refineries on T9-T10 :)

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Until you're up at T8, I wouldn't bother going above level 7 or so. Materials are extremely valuable at high levels, and you'll be without your gear for a long time if you hit levels 8 9 or 10.


By then, you spend enough time in the class to warrant more investment in equipment.
